title: One Tiny Hello
originalStory: A little firefly sat on a clover leaf, too shy to flash his light. When another firefly blinked from the grass, he answered with one tiny glow. They blinked back and forth like little green stars, and he didn’t feel so alone.
visualBible:
Pip: a small adult male firefly with a round dark-brown body, amber wing covers, six delicate legs, short antennae, and a soft green tail light; no hair or clothes.
Fern: a slightly larger adult female firefly with a slender charcoal body, chestnut wing covers, six delicate legs, long curved antennae, and a bright green tail light; no hair or clothes.

pages.text: Pip sat on a clover leaf, too shy to flash his light. All around him, the grass whispered in the evening breeze. He tucked his little legs close and wished saying hello could be easier.
pages.illustrationScene: Gentle cartoon illustration in a close-up of a low clover patch at dusk. Pip, a small round dark-brown firefly with amber wing covers and short antennae, sits alone on a broad clover leaf just above the soft meadow ground, with six legs tucked close and tail light unlit. Curving grass surrounds the quiet, cozy scene.

pages.text: Across the grass, Fern blinked once—a little green star. “Hello?” her light seemed to say. Pip waited one breath, then answered with one tiny glow.
pages.illustrationScene: Gentle cartoon illustration in a wide view of a soft, level meadow at dusk. On the left, Pip, the small round dark-brown firefly with amber wing covers and short antennae, gives a tiny green glow from a low clover leaf. Several grass tufts away on the right, Fern, the slightly larger slender charcoal firefly with chestnut wing covers and long curved antennae, flashes a brighter green light from a low blade of grass. The space between the two feels quiet and welcoming.

pages.text: Fern blinked again, and Pip blinked back. Between the clover and the daisies, their little green hellos went back and forth. Each time Pip answered, the next hello felt a little easier.
pages.illustrationScene: Gentle cartoon illustration from ground level at the edge of a daisy patch beside the clover. Pip, small and round with a dark-brown body, amber wing covers, and short antennae, glows on a low clover leaf. Fern, slightly larger and slender with a charcoal body, chestnut wing covers, and long curved antennae, glows on a low grass blade nearby. Two distinct green lights shine among softly textured leaves, with daisy petals above and comfortable meadow ground below; the mood is playful and tender.

pages.text: At last, Fern settled on the clover leaf beside him. Pip made one small blink: “Hello, again.” His light was still tiny, but now there was someone beside him to see it.
pages.illustrationScene: Gentle cartoon illustration in an intimate close-up of one broad, low clover leaf above soft meadow ground. Pip, the small round dark-brown firefly with amber wing covers and short antennae, sits beside Fern, the slightly larger slender charcoal firefly with chestnut wing covers and long curved antennae. Pip's tiny green tail light softly illuminates the leaf between the two resting fireflies. The surrounding grass is gently blurred, creating a warm feeling of companionship.
